subject: Procurement readiness check after demo — PR creation & Coupa setup
messages:
From: Emily Ramos <procurement@alphacorp.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@alphacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo procurement check — PR path & supplier setup

Hi Connor / Laura,

Thanks for walking us through the platform this morning — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the observed cost controls. Before we get to contract, procurement asked me to confirm a few things so we can start the internal PR (purchase requisition) and supplier onboarding: 

1) Commercial path: we prefer using our marketplace (CloudMarket) if Redwood is listed; otherwise Procurement is comfortable doing a traditional PO. We can do a corporate card for the initial POC if needed but that requires legal sign-off for PCI exposure. Which options do you recommend for a ~6 month POC at ~40k USD?

2) Supplier/setup: Procurement needs Redwood's legal company name, W-9 (or local tax form), and the preferred billing contact. If you already have a Coupa supplier ID (or Ariba), please share it — that speeds onboarding.

3) PR line items: can you provide a short, copy-paste PR line (description, quantity, unit price, GL code suggestion) for our Coupa template? Also let us know if we should route approvals to finance only or include IT procurement.

I attached a draft SOW and the procurement intake form so you can see the fields they require.

Next steps: if you can reply with the supplier info + a PR sample by EOD Wednesday we can kick the internal workflow.

Thanks,
Emily Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager | AlphaCorp
procurement@alphacorp.com
Attachment: AlphaCorp_SOW_Draft.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Ramos <procurement@alphacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement check — PR path & supplier setup

Hi Emily — great to meet you earlier. Quick answers and I'll put the PR template below so you can paste into Coupa.

1) Recommended commercial path: If Redwood is listed in CloudMarket, that will be fastest (no supplier onboarding). If not, PO is the typical route for enterprise procurement. Corporate card is an option for a short POC but expect additional underwriting and a slightly slower legal review. For a 6-month POC at ~$40k, PO is our usual recommendation — predictable invoicing and easier to tie to committed capacity.

2) Supplier info (for your vendor system):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing contact: Billing Ops <billing@redwood.ai>
- Tax: US EIN 82-249XXXX (we'll send a formal W-9 as an attachment)

3) PR line (copy into Coupa):
- Description: Redwood Inference — Dedicated Inference Capacity (June 2027 POC) — 1 unit (reserved capacity) — Includes model serving, observability, and 24/7 support
- Quantity: 1
- Unit price: USD 40,000.00
- GL suggestion: 6240 (Software Licensing / SaaS)
- Contract term reference: RDW-7421 (attach SOW)

Routing suggestion: finance -> IT procurement -> legal (if vendor onboarding required). If CloudMarket, finance alone is often sufficient.

Attaching our redwood_vendor_info.zip (contains W-9, billing instructions, and payment terms) and a short sample invoice template. Laura, looping you to confirm internal PR template and any required field mapping for Coupa vs Ariba.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_vendor_info.zip
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement check — PR path & supplier setup

Connor — adding internal procurement guidance and a ready-to-paste PR template for AlphaCorp. Use this when you hear back — it aligns with our standard supplier onboarding and should reduce back-and-forth. I've also opened ticket IT-1879 to request our Coupa buyer profile be linked (saves the customer effort). See link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-1879

Procurement readiness checklist (quick):
- Confirm legal name + W-9 (done; included in the zip).
- Decide marketplace vs direct PO. Marketplace = fastest. PO = standard if vendor not listed. Card = for trial only; needs cardholder approval.
- Supplier onboarding: If customer uses Coupa/Ariba, we need either their supplier ID or to complete their vendor onboarding form (we prefer to supply our vendor packet). Assign to Marissa if they need additional docs.
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (will accept emailed invoices and EDI if configured).

Coupa PR template (copy-paste into the "Line Items" section):
- Item: Redwood Inference - Dedicated Inference Capacity (PO: RDW-7421)
- Item Description: 6-month POC reserved capacity; includes inference runtime, monitoring, and support.
- Qty: 1
- Unit Price: 40,000.00
- Account/GL: 6240
- Delivery date: 2027-06-01

Field mapping notes (Coupa -> Redwood recommendations):
- Supplier ID: provide if you have it. If not, attach vendor packet to the PR and mark "New Supplier".
- Payment terms: Net 30 (unless CloudMarket requires platform-specific terms).
- Attachments: attach signed SOW and our vendor packet.

Ticketing: I've attached a PR template CSV (PR_Template_Coupa.csv) to drop into Coupa if they allow. If they ask for a supplier ID, pass that request directly to Marissa (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: PR_Template_Coupa.csv

Thanks — Alicia in ops will start the PR this morning and try the marketplace lookup first. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- Can you confirm if Redwood already has a CloudMarket listing or a Coupa supplier ID? If so please provide the ID.
- Who should be the primary billing contact name/email on the PO? We'll use billing@redwood.ai but some systems need a contact person too.

We'll attach the SOW and vendor packet to the PR and tag it for finance routing (finance -> IT procurement). If we hit a supplier onboarding form we may route to Marissa.
